title: Data World: Scaling Data Environments from Scratch
snippet: Data agents use code to process heterogeneous files and derive analytical insights. Scaling their training faces costly environment curation, privacy and intellectual-property restrictions, and difficulty verifying open-ended findings without known generative truth. summary: Data World is a multi-agent engine that synthesizes environments, tasks and rubrics for training data agents by specifying the underlying world before generating files, with audits and rubrics usable as RL rewards.

title: RoTA-Bench: Evaluating 3D Spatial Reasoning through Interactive Projection Alignment
snippet: Can vision-language models turn 2D observations into 3D understanding that supports precise action? summary: RoTA-Bench tests whether vision-language models can recover a target silhouette by choosing successive 3D rotations of an object within a limited action budget, probing 3D spatial reasoning.

summary: Routing Policy Optimization introduces exploration for diffusion RL by randomizing attention routing at selected denoising levels, preserving the original sampler instead of perturbing the reverse trajectory.

summary: OpenGCUA is an ongoing project to build a fully open stack for generalist computer-use agents spanning visual and programmatic interfaces, noting that frontier systems like GPT-6 Astra's remain closed.

title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
snippet: Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. summary: OmniVerifier-C1 is a generative visual verifier that decomposes complex prompts or rules into components and gives graded pointwise scores instead of binary True/False judgments.

title: WorldCast: Exploring Intelligent Visual Generation in World State Prediction
snippet: Humans interpret multimodal observations of the world and forecast how it will evolve. summary: WorldCast proposes a four-level hierarchy of multimodal generative model capabilities and evaluates multi-step world state prediction, a higher-level task it finds underexplored.

title: InfiniSplat v2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward 3DGS from Any Views
snippet: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction builds 3D scenes directly from input images for novel view rendering, but learning Gaussian attributes from predicted geometry for high-quality rendering under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. summary: InfiniSplat v2 improves feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting by decoupling geometry and attribute prediction with a frozen geometry branch, aligning Gaussians using ground-truth camera poses in training, and using large-angle target views.

title: MJev-Spatial: System One Spatial Intelligence via Native Attention Matching
snippet: Spatial intelligence lets an agent perceive and act in the physical world, and many of its judgments must be made at interaction rates: which spatial relation holds, how far an object is, or where to place it. snippet: We propose DeltaStreamer, a novel agentic framework for streaming video understanding inspired by how humans observe, remember, and investigate. summary: DeltaStreamer is an agentic framework for streaming video understanding that combines change-aware memory with query-driven planning and replay to gather missing visual evidence.

snippet: Vision-language-action (VLA) models transfer semantic knowledge acquired through vision-language pretraining to robot control, achieving strong performance across various benchmarks. snippet: Most existing agentic reinforcement learning methods assume single-session trajectories, where interaction proceeds within one continuously accumulated context. title: Velox: Spatial Memory Makes World Models Efficient

Chunked video diffusion models usually keep this context in growing KV caches, so later chunks become progressively slower. summary: Velox is a training-free attention router that selects region-level context for video world models using frustum slab correspondences from streaming geometry. It aims to avoid the growing KV caches that slow later chunks in chunked video diffusion rollouts.
whyItMatters: Keeping long interactive video generation fast without retraining could make world-model simulation more practical.
